//: Least-privilege manifest for the Purchase Order Reader.
These scopes are declared EXPLICITLY so the Google consent screen shows
exactly what the app can do — and, just as importantly, what it CANNOT do.
Every scope below is the narrowest one that still lets the feature work.
gmail.readonly              Read messages only. The app physically cannot
send, delete, forward, or alter your mail. If
this script were ever compromised, the worst it
could do to Gmail is read the purchase-order
inbox it is already allowed to read.
spreadsheets.currentonly    Write to ONLY the one spreadsheet this script
is bound to. It cannot open, read, or write any
other sheet in the shared Drive.
script.scriptapp            Create the single time-based trigger.
userinfo.email              Read the signed-in viewer's address so the web
The Gmail advanced service (below) is what makes gmail.readonly possible.
The convenience GmailApp class would force the far broader
https://mail.google.com/ scope (full send + delete). We use the REST Gmail
service instead precisely to keep mail access read-only.
